published_items.summary: The European Parliament's Legislative Observatory procedure file for 2026/0265(COD) lists meetings with interest representatives published in line with the Rules of Procedure, including a meeting on 14 October 2026 with Fairtrade Labelling Organizations International e.V. It also lists meetings on 13 October 2026 with Upphandlingsmyndigheten and on 9 October 2026 with LO Sverige.

The European Commission opened a public consultation on EU rules on biobased feedstock in plastic packaging (reference Ares(2026)9620334), with feedback open from 21 October 2026 to 13 January 2027. The initiative is listed as ACTIVE with front-end stage OPC_LAUNCHED and a foreseen act type of PROP_REG.

On 21 October 2026, the Commission opened a consultation on bio-based plastic packaging. The results will inform an assessment of the technological development and environmental performance of bio-based plastic packaging.

quarantined_items.title: Waste Shipment Regulation
quarantined_items.summary: The feedback period on the draft regulation listing the non-OECD countries authorised to import certain non-hazardous waste from the EU closed on 16 October 2026. The regulation relates to the ban on exporting non-hazardous waste to non-OECD countries from 21 May 2027.
reasons: L3 high-impact confirmation: partially_supported (confidence 0.80); Interpretation adds a new obligation not present in the source: 'Exporters of non-hazardous waste will need to confirm that their destination appears on the delegated list before shipping after 21 May 2027.' The source states the ban and the existence of a list but does not impose any explicit confirmation requirement on exporters.

quarantined_items.title: PPWR
quarantined_items.summary: A planned regulation on EU rules on biobased feedstock in plastic packaging, reference Ares(2026)9620334, is listed with an active initiative status and a front-end stage of 'INIT_PLANNED'. Receiving feedback is disabled, and the listed feedback start date is 19 October 2026.
reasons: L3 reviewer: partially_supported (confidence 0.88); The interpretation introduces 'recycled-content rules' as a related compliance layer, but the source does not mention recycled-content rules or any relationship to them.; The interpretation asserts that the initiative 'would add a further compliance layer' and affect brand owners/converters; this is speculative and goes beyond what the source states.

quarantined_items.title: PPWR
quarantined_items.summary: The Council agreed a negotiating position on a proposal for a regulation suspending extended producer responsibility. The stated aim is to cut red tape for small packaging producers.

quarantined_items.title: UK packaging EPR
quarantined_items.summary: Small producers registering for the 2027 reporting year must pay a registration fee of £1,303 if they register directly with their environmental regulator, or £696 if they register through a compliance scheme. Those using a compliance scheme must also pay fees to the scheme for its services.
reasons: L3 reviewer: partially_supported (confidence 0.92); The 2027 registration deadline is misstated: the source says small producers must submit their 2027 registration application by 1 October 2026. The 1 April 2027 date applies only if their sole packaging activity is selling filled packaging directly to an end user.; The key date claiming a 2026-04-01 deadline for the 2026 registration application is not supported; the source says the deadline for 2026 was 1 October 2025.; The 2027-04-01 key date conflates the correct reporting deadline for January to December 2026 packaging data with a general 2027 registration deadline, which is not 1 April 2027 for all small producers.; The next-step entry stating that 1 April 2027 is the deadline for small producers to submit their 2027 registration application is unsupported except for the narrow end-user sale exception.

quarantined_items.title: Public Procurement Regulation
quarantined_items.summary: The European Commission's public feedback period on the revision of EU rules on public procurement opened on 15 September 2026 and is scheduled to run until 11 December 2026. The initiative is listed with the status active and the receiving-feedback status open.

quarantined_items.title: Industrial Accelerator Act
quarantined_items.summary: Amendments to the committee draft report on the Industrial Accelerator Act proposal (2026/0068(COD)) were tabled in committee on 19 October 2026 (PE796.455). A committee opinion from ENVI (PE789.106) on the proposal is recorded with the date 22 October 2026.

editorial_review.notes: The issue is held for one history conflict and one interpretation fact issue. The public procurement item conflicts with the recorded end date of the consultation; the Industrial Accelerator Act interpretation adds a fact not in the source excerpt. The issue also has duplicate coverage of the bio-based packaging consultation and inconsistent spelling of biobased/bio-based and recycled content hyphenation. High-impact quarantined items for eu-wsr, uk-pepr, and the Council EPR-suspension update under eu-ppwr are absent and should be considered by the publish gate.
